value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Arcata/Humboldt County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value: Call the Building Department's main line at (707) 822-5956 at least 24 hours ahead of the requested inspection time
The inspector arrives on-site at or near the scheduled time; inspections are recorded on the Inspection Record Card issued with the building permit
Electric and/or Gas Tags are required by PG&E prior to connection of services
A Final Inspection concludes the project, with both the Job Copy and Office Copy of the Inspection Record Card signed
inspection_steps.notes: Per the City's own 'Inspection Services and Guidelines FAQ's' PDF; this is the general Building Division inspection process (covers all permit types, including solar), not a solar-specific sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited, streamlined permitting for small residential rooftop solar energy systems (municipal ordinance)
other_conditions: A small system is defined as no larger than 10kW AC nameplate rating or 30kW thermal
The city cannot yet accept permit signatures and fee payment through electronic submittal due to bank/software/administrative restrictions, though it intends to once available

value.role: City of Arcata Building Department (main line)
